BUILT WORKFLOW & FEATURE GROUPS

What Sales & Intelligence
helps your team do.

Capabilities built in the current workspace or pilot scope. Provider-dependent connections are noted explicitly.

01

Ideal customer profile

Define target sectors, locations and exclusions to score prospect fit transparently.

02

Prospect records

Company and contact details, source evidence, ownership, notes and transactional CSV import with preview and duplicate checks.

03

Qualification

Assess fit separately from data confidence and contactability, and highlight missing information clearly.

04

Sales Action Queue

Prioritise overdue tasks, accounts needing an owner, engaged prospects and new prospects to review.

05

Quote follow-up

Record a quote reference, owner and date. Surface overdue quotes and clear the reminder when the quote is accepted, declined or withdrawn (current scope: one tracked quote per prospect).

06

Pipeline and follow-up

Record sales activity, replies and meetings, assign actions and run approved sequences for staff tasks.

07

Campaign preparation

Draft outreach, review exact rendered previews and record owner approvals in a controlled review queue.

08

Handover

Prepare a structured Sales export for operator review before Business Delivery onboarding.

09

Marketing outcomes

Record a source campaign and confirmed qualification, attendance or win milestones, then export the results JSON for Marketing reporting.

HOW THE PLATFORMS WORK TOGETHER

From first enquiry
to delivery.

A practical example of how an enquiry moves across the seven platforms. Manual exports, browser imports and operator confirmations keep people in control at each boundary.

Not automatically synchronised end to end: handovers use structured exports, browser review and operator confirmation.

  1. 01 · Communications Team workspace / configured channelCaptures an enquiry and gives it an owner.

    Inbound calls, chat or messages are recorded and assigned to a team member with a clear next step.

  2. 02 · Sales & Intelligence Operator qualification & JSON exportQualifies the opportunity and tracks the next step.

    Sales assesses fit and data confidence, tracks quote follow-up, records campaign outcomes and exports a structured handover.

  3. 03 · CRM Scoped Business CRM workspaceRetains the account history and relationship actions.

    Account dossiers, contacts, decision-makers, tasks and 30-day renewal review flags stay visible to the team.

  4. 04 · AI Team Browser preview & downloaded instructionsHelps prepare the delivery brief for human review.

    An operator previews the Sales handover in the browser, enters agreed delivery details and downloads instructions for Automation.

  5. 05 · Automation Operator-controlled pilot runRoutes the reviewed handover.

    The operator runs the route to Business Delivery using the handover reference to prevent duplicate records and logs the outcome.

  6. 06 · Business Delivery Pilot handover import & confirmationCreates an owned onboarding record.

    Delivery imports the handover, confirms the deal is won and scope is agreed, and records the delivery owner and start date.

  7. 07 · Marketing & Social Media Browser JSON importReports which source campaigns produced sales outcomes.

    Marketing imports the Sales outcomes JSON in the browser to compare leads, qualified leads, attended meetings and wins.
